recognize_zh: 抹片被一片單一型態的小至中型淋巴球佔滿，核圓、染色質塊狀、胞質極少，其間夾雜一顆核較大、染色質較淡的前淋巴球／副免疫母細胞，符合 CLL 骨髓浸潤。
features: Dense monotonous population of small to intermediate lymphocytes replacing normal elements
Round to slightly indented nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin
High N:C ratio with scant pale blue cytoplasm
Occasional larger cell with oval nucleus and more open chromatin (prolymphocyte/paraimmunoblast)
Scattered clear vacuoles and red cells in the background; normal hematopoietic precursors not evident
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows near-complete replacement by a monotonous population of small to intermediate-sized lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm. Occasional larger cells with more open chromatin, consistent with prolymphocytes or paraimmunoblasts, are admixed. Normal trilineage hematopoietic precursors are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma, to be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD5+, CD23+, dim sIg).

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma cells have more irregular, cleaved nuclei and are CD23-negative, cyclin D1/SOX11-positive with t(11;14).
LPL includes plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, and is usually CD5- and CD23-.
Hematogones have finely homogeneous chromatin and show a maturing CD10/CD34/TdT immunophenotypic spectrum rather than a clonal CD5+ population.
Richter transformation shows sheets of large cells with nucleoli, whereas here large cells are only occasional within a small cell background.
